title: TOVBrachistochrone v2.1.0: verification suite for brachistochrones inside static stars

creators.name: Rosignoli, Iman
creators.affiliation: Department of Physics, University of Pavia

description:
Reproducibility package of the paper Brachistochrones inside static stars: existence, global minimality and exact results for two uniform-density interiors.

A particle released from rest at the surface of a static star slides on a frictionless rail through the interior; minimizing the coordinate or the proper travel time is a Fermat problem for an optical metric that is singular at the surface. Version 2 checks the results of the mathematical paper: the genus-two reduction and the closed forms of the uniform-density (Schwarzschild interior) rails, apertures and travel times; the complete third-kind lemma; the exact thresholds of regular turning radii, of the central slope and of the curvature criteria; the global monotonicity of the aperture (proper time up to the curvature threshold, coordinate time up to μ = 429/625 with a rational certificate for the sign of the central slope), the exact single sign change of the integral-criterion function up to the splitting threshold, and the Hamilton–Jacobi identity and the antipodal comparison; the limiting model at the Buchdahl bound and a numerical candidate for a proper-time coexistence separation; and the anisotropic Florides interior beyond the Buchdahl bound.

Thirteen Wolfram Language jobs (266 checks) record exact symbolic decisions, numerical checks, diagnostics and negative controls in versioned JSON; tools/run_verification.py runs the profiles quick, full and release and validates each result against the manifest. RESULTS_MAP.md indexes the results covered by the suite, each with its script, its checks and its kind of evidence; some entries are analytic only, and the analytic proof steps are listed as not executed. The report of the release run on a clean checkout, with the recorded versions of the environment (Wolfram 13.3.1, Python, platform) and the SHA-256 of every verification file, is in results/release/v2.1.0/ (the report of version 2.0.0 is kept in results/release/v2.0.0/); the release profile needs a Git clone of the tag, the archive can be checked with the full profile. Version 1 (numerical code of the 2026 submission) is kept in legacy_v1/.
notes: Version 2.1.0: coordinate-time uniqueness extended from mu <= 16/25 to mu <= 429/625 (new exact decisions and a rational certificate for C_t(429/625) < 0), exact partial results and diagnostics on the shape of the coordinate-time aperture beyond that range, and two new analytic entries in RESULTS_MAP.md (strengthened integral criterion, scalar selection of minimizers). Version 2.0.0: complete rewrite as the verification suite of the mathematical paper (v1 numerical code moved to legacy_v1/). Requirements: wolframscript (tested with 13.3.1) and Python 3.10 or later; the v2 runner uses the Python standard library only. The release records the versions of the environment; it does not ship an installable environment.
